displayName: 团结乡样本 01 · 墙体风化、云南瓦作与旧木色参考
purpose: 把用户确认的实物表观证据转成生产线可复用的材质、构造识别与质量门槛，同时避免从扫描外观虚构尺寸、材料配比或隐蔽做法。

userConfirmedOn2026_08_21: The visible earthen-wall surface is a representative long-term weathered state and must not be dismissed as a texture defect.
The visible roof-tile relationship is representative of traditional Yunnan tile roofing and is an approved visual reference for this production line.
The visible colors of the exterior timber members are approved as reference colors for aged local timber work.
directVisualObservations: The main wall field is warm reddish earth-ochre with irregular loss, rounded erosion and exposed coarse courses or clods.
Lower and side wall areas contain pale gray-white patches, darker staining and repairs or deposits whose exact causes cannot be separated from the scan alone.
The roof reads as discrete gray ceramic pieces with alternating concave field channels and convex cover rows, visible downslope overlap rhythm and rounded eave ends.
Tile color and roughness vary locally; ridge and eave lines retain small age-related irregularities rather than a perfectly straight manufactured finish.
Exterior timber reads as matte, low-saturation gray-brown to dark brown, with exposure-dependent variation and no uniform bright red-orange coating.
domainInformedInterpretation: The approved visible relationship is consistent with a pan-tile and cover-tile system in which lower pan tiles drain water and upper cover tiles bridge adjacent joints.
Wall appearance should be reproduced as layered exposure, erosion, patching and staining zones rather than as uniform procedural noise.
unresolved: exact earth composition, lifts, binders and construction sequence
whether each pale wall patch is lime wash, mineral deposit, repair mortar, exposed substrate or a combination
wood species, original coating, repair date and replacement-member chronology
individual pan-tile and cover-tile dimensions, taper, course spacing, longitudinal lap, bedding, fastening and hidden roof build-up
exact ridge, verge, eave closure and drainage details

productionReferenceSystems.label: 长期风化土墙
appearanceLayers: coarse exposed and rounded erosion zones
pale gray-white patch or deposit zones
darker runoff, damp-looking or sheltered staining zones
implementationGuidance: Use large-scale non-repeating masks aligned to exposure and construction zones.
Preserve height-dependent and shelter-dependent variation at wall base, openings, eaves and corners.
Keep displacement or normal relief subordinate to the scanned wall form; do not replace real surface relief with generic noise.
Retain local repairs and surface loss as readable patches instead of homogenizing the wall.
rejectIf: surface is uniformly clean or uniformly noisy
wall becomes polished concrete, stucco or a seamless brick texture
weathering is reduced to random speckles with no exposure logic
scan holes, floating fragments or occlusion spikes are copied as architectural fabric

productionReferenceSystems.label: 云南传统板瓦—筒瓦旧瓦面
visibleRelationship: convex cover-tile rows bridging adjacent pan-tile joints
locally varied gray ceramic color and roughness
implementationGuidance: Model tile pieces or instanced modules as discrete units; a single corrugated sheet is not an acceptable substitute.
Keep pan and cover roles readable at eaves and close oblique views.
Use restrained variation in tone, roughness, edge wear and alignment while preserving a coherent drainage direction.
Retain small ridge and eave irregularities that are supported by the scan, but do not amplify photogrammetry noise.
rejectIf: roof resembles metal, fiber-cement or continuous corrugated sheeting
all ribs are continuous from ridge to eave with no individual-tile overlap
pan and cover roles cannot be distinguished at the eave
tile dimensions or lap are asserted as measured from this scan without a control scale

productionReferenceSystems.label: 云南旧木构综合色
appearanceLayers: dark brown sheltered, end-grain or accumulated-finish zones
implementationGuidance: Use the high-resolution scan as the color anchor for exterior posts, rails, boards and door leaves.
Separate color variation by exposure and member role rather than applying one saturated wood material everywhere.
Preserve a matte aged response and restrained specular highlights.
rejectIf: all timber is bright orange, glossy red or newly varnished
different exposure zones share an identical flat material
wood species or historic coating is named without separate evidence

scanArtifactExclusions: holes caused by occlusion or missing photography
floating fragments and clipped background surfaces
texture seams, blur and projection contamination
geometry fused across unrelated surfaces by photogrammetry
pipelineUses: material and weathering art direction for Yunnan courtyard scans and procedural reconstructions
roof QA for rejecting corrugated-sheet substitutes
close-view comparison in the Tuanjie reference viewer
future sample-to-sample regional comparison after evidence is kept separate per building
qaGates: Wall weathering remains zoned and physically plausible rather than uniformly noisy.
Roof reads as discrete pan-and-cover ceramic tile work in silhouette, eave view and close oblique view.
Timber stays within the approved low-saturation gray-brown to dark-brown family.
No exact tile, wall or timber construction dimension is promoted without sample-specific measurement evidence.
Photogrammetry artifacts remain excluded from reusable architectural rules.
